item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 21
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s weekly release roundup adds new models, local sandboxing in the Copilot app, and updates across Copilot integrations in Slack, Microsoft Teams, JetBrains, and VS Code.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New features and improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.18.0 adds AI-assisted tool approvals, more control over agent conversations, and organization-wide shared skills and instructions. It also includes plan review support with Codex.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise-managed sandbox in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise-managed sandbox policies, along with cross-file cursor jumps for next edit suggestions, global project context in chat, and enterprise policy diagnostics. The update also adds a new terminal Copilot connection.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise managed settings in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise managed settings. Administrators can centrally control plugin governance, MCP server access, OpenTelemetry, and permission modes across the enterprise.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot memory and Ollama in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains adds persistent memory, local model access via Ollama, and additional enterprise controls. The update also improves chat workflows and fixes reliability issues with MCP servers.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains adds improved OpenTelemetry configuration and model management
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now includes improved OpenTelemetry configuration and model management. The update also adds support for connecting MCP servers and custom agents in Claude agent flows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains expands BYOK capabilities
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now supports expanded bring-your-own-key (BYOK) customization across all Copilot tiers, with broader model provider flexibility and improved plugin/provider experiences. The update also includes changes to conversational interactions in the IDE.

  • Source: GitHub
